articles.title: PFRDA extends NPS same-day investment deadline to improve subscriber experience, enhance operational efficiency
articles.summary: PFRDA has extended the NPS same-day investment cut-off from 11 am to 1:30 pm, allowing more contributions to qualify for same-day investment. The revised deadline applies across all major NPS payment channels, improving flexibility, operational efficiency and the subscriber experience.

articles.title: When porting a health policy puts your claim at risk
articles.summary: Health insurance portability was designed to empower India's policyholders through choice and competition, but its real-world impact remains limited.

articles.title: Radhika Gupta says REITs are not fixed-income investments, but differ from equities: Here’s what another expert thinks
articles.summary: REITs are often mistaken for fixed-income products due to their regular payouts, but they carry equity-like risks. Their returns depend on rental income, occupancy and property cycles, making them a diversification tool rather than a substitute for debt investments.

articles.title: Selling US-listed shares after returning to India? Here's how they are taxed
articles.summary: The Indian tax law does not provide any special exemption or relief for losses or gains arising solely due to depreciation of the Indian rupee against the foreign currency during the investment period.

articles.title: Will UPI payments remain free forever? Bernstein says consumers likely to stay unaffected; 30-40 bps MDR possible
articles.summary: UPI users may remain unaffected even if Merchant Discount Rate is introduced, according to Bernstein. The brokerage expects large merchants to bear a 30-40 bps fee, while small merchants and low-value transactions may remain exempt. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra says it is too early to comment.

articles.title: Best FD interest rates in India: Check fixed deposit returns of DCB Bank, RBL Bank, YES Bank and more
articles.summary: Interest rates on fixed deposits differ significantly among banks. Investors should consider factors such as bank reputation and financial goals when choosing deposit options with varying maturities.

articles.title: ITR-6 Excel utility for AY 2026-27 released: Eligibility, due dates, key documents explained
articles.summary: The Income Tax Department has released the Excel utility for ITR-6 for AY 2026-27. The utility is now available on the e-Filing portal. The form is applicable to companies that are not claiming exemption under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act.

articles.title: Boost your savings on autopilot: How cash optimisation apps put your surplus money to work
articles.summary: Cash optimisation apps allow you to park unused money in liquid mutual funds or fixed deposits, delivering higher yields than standard savings accounts.

articles.title: EPFO may launch E-PRAAPTI by August-end: How the new portal can help you trace old or inactive PF accounts
articles.summary: The EPFO is expected to launch E-PRAAPTI by the end of August to help members recover money lying in old or inactive PF accounts. The Aadhaar-based portal aims to simplify account tracing, reduce paperwork, enable UAN linking, and make claims faster through a digital process.

articles.title: RBI holds repo rate at 5.25%: 5 assumptions about EMIs, FD rates and inflation salaried employees shouldn't make
articles.summary: The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% while raising its FY27 growth forecast and trimming its inflation estimate. Here's why salaried employees shouldn't expect lower EMIs, cheaper loans or sharply lower FD rates just yet.

articles.title: Does Section 54F tax exemption apply if LTCG is used to buy property from spouse? Here's what the ITAT ruling says
articles.summary: The Mumbai ITAT ruled that a genuine property purchase from a spouse cannot be denied Section 54F tax exemption merely because it results in tax savings. The tribunal found no evidence of tax avoidance and allowed a taxpayer's ₹6.92 crore exemption claim after the tax department challenged it.

articles.title: RBI policy remains unchanged — but is this the right time to revisit and strengthen your emergency fund strategy?
